title: Stochastic World Models for Verifying Vision-Based Neural Feedback Systems
abstract: arXiv:2609.38120v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Verifying a vision-based neural feedback system requires a model of the observations its controller acts upon. Such a model must capture the variation the sensor produces, while remaining tractable for closed-loop analysis. Generative adversarial networks (GANs) have served as perception surrogates, but they are large, reproduce complex scenes poorly, and are hard to verify. We explore stochastic world models as a richer class of perception surrogates. We train a world model with physically grounded latents, built from operations that standard verifiers bound. It reproduces held-out frames more faithfully than GAN surrogates with up to 130 times as many parameters. To verify these surrogates, we develop a procedure that combines falsification, adaptive refinement, symbolic, and backward analyses. translated_title: 用于验证基于视觉的神经反馈系统的随机世界模型
translated_abstract: 验证一个基于视觉的神经反馈系统需要一个能够描述其控制器所依据的观测的模型。这样的模型必须能够捕捉传感器产生的变化，同时保持对闭环分析的可处理性。生成对抗网络（GAN）曾被用作感知代理，但它们规模庞大、难以逼真地重现复杂场景，且难以验证。我们探索了随机世界模型作为更丰富的一类感知代理。我们训练了一个具有物理基础潜变量的世界模型，该模型由标准验证器可以约束的操作构建而成。与参数数量多达其130倍的GAN代理相比，该模型对留出帧的重建更加逼真。为了验证这些代理，我们开发了一种结合了证伪、自适应细化、符号分析与反向分析的流程。在一个使用GAN代理的紧急制动基准测试中，我们的流程解决了整个状态空间，而最先进的验证器仅能处理其中的38%（摘要至此截断）。
tldr: 本文提出以具有物理基础潜变量的随机世界模型替代GAN作为感知代理来验证基于视觉的神经反馈系统，在参数少130倍的情况下重建更逼真，并开发了结合证伪、自适应细化、符号分析与反向分析的验证流程，在紧急制动基准上解决了最先进验证器仅能覆盖38%的整个状态空间。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes stochastic world models with physically grounded latents as perception surrogates for verifying vision-based neural feedback systems, achieving more faithful frame reconstruction than GAN surrogates with up to 130 times fewer parameters, and develops a verification procedure combining falsification, adaptive refinement, symbolic, and backward analyses that resolves the entire state space on an emergency braking benchmark where the state-of-the-art verifier only covered 38%.
